summary: Checked all changed declarations (Integral, quot, rem, IntegralOps, /, %, /%, mkNumericOps, Integral.apply, ExtraImplicits, infixIntegralOps) against their bodies/signatures; all descriptions and @param/@return content match the actual implementation, including the corrected `Integral[T]#IntegralOps` return type on infixIntegralOps. Only one minor tag-placement nit found on /%.

items.issue: The `@param rhs` tag conflates the parameter description with return-value information ("the divisor; the method returns a tuple of (quotient, remainder)"), and uses the self-referential phrase "the method". The first-sentence description already satisfies the @return-drop rule (starts with "Returns" and states the return), so the tuple-order detail should either be folded into that sentence or placed in a separate `@return` tag, not appended to the `@param` tag.
items.suggestion: Change to `@param rhs the divisor` and, if the tuple order needs stating explicitly, add `@return a tuple of (quotient, remainder)` or fold "as a tuple of (quotient, remainder)" into the first sentence.
